works.title: Desert Property Modification: Rat Exclusion and Sand Management System
works.description: A comprehensive home/property improvement project for a desert property involving engineered rat exclusion barriers, sand/dust management through window modifications with custom polycarbonate, and integrated air filtration system design to maintain interior air quality while excluding sand ingress.
